name: UCO Bank
title: UCO Bank - 532505 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: UCO Bank Q2 FY27 shows strong loan growth (24.7% YoY) and falling GNPA (1.96%), but NIM guidance held only by repo-linked loans, and Q2 slippages rose QoQ to Rs 549 crore, partly from agri marking.

triggers.label: Repo-linked loans ~66% of advances
triggers.quote: we have around 66% of our advances portfolio linked with the repo rate

triggers.label: Slippages up QoQ to Rs 549 crore
triggers.quote: the higher slippages are only due to the agriculture marking

triggers.label: Advances growth 24.7% vs 12-14% guide, not raised
triggers.quote: we will try to grow more than that, of course

triggers.label: Treasury pressure from hardening yields
triggers.quote: the treasury profitability is under pressure

guidance.quote: we have given guidance of 12%-14% growth in advances
We have given guidance of 2.80%-2.90%, and we are maintaining our global yield beyond that.
we expect to maintain it below the guidance, 0.75%, going forward also for the current financial year
our guidance for the net NPA ratio was to bring it down below 0.25% for the year
For the full year also, we will be maintaining around 50%.
On our slippage ratio we had also given guidance to keep it below 1%

guidance.value: not guided as number; 36.77%, slightly lower QoQ
guidance.quote: our CASA ratio has been maintained at 36.77%. This is slightly lower than the June quarter.

prior_guidance_check.quote: while we had given growth guidance in deposits of 10 to 12%, our growth has been 14% plus
We had given guidance in advances growth of 12 to 14%; the growth has been 24.70%.
we have already, in the half year, brought it down to below 2%, and our GNPA ratio is 1.96%
in the half year itself we have brought it down to below 0.20%, that is 0.18%
we have reached 65%; we have already crossed 65% in this quarter in RAM share

red_flags.label: Q2 recoveries and treasury cushion reliant on repo pass-through
red_flags.quote: this will more or less compensate for the treasury losses, if you see any, going ahead

red_flags.label: Provisioning accelerated to hit net NPA guidance
red_flags.quote: So, we have done accelerated provisioning to achieve the guidance

red_flags.label: Opex jump Rs 160 crore QoQ
red_flags.quote: Other operating expenses in this quarter have gone up a little bit, by 160 crore.

red_flags.label: Deposit growth below advances; CD ratio rising to 82.29%
red_flags.quote: our CD ratio has improved to 82.29%, as against 75.47% in the previous year

evasions.quote: I will not take any guess on the future growth rates as of now.
we have not analyzed it separately
